purpose: Prevent a known human-animal head fusion from being recycled as a successful final restoration. Exact SHA-based veto; not an AI semantic-quality certification.

rejections.review_basis: User inspected real generated screenshot and identified a visually obvious blend of the man's shoulder/head region with a horned animal's head. Additional risk of merged animal horns/heads in crowded herd.
rejections.what_to_do: Select and VISUALLY REVIEW a different less cluttered real frame with separated head and shoulders, verify true movement before freeze, regenerate with source-locked model and compare image at 100% and 200%, including human and animal segmentation; discard if contact fused. If no good frame in this sequence, keep brief original moving film but choose a different fifth shot/film for photo or Vidu.
rejections.notes: Automatic geometry/saturation scores passed this photo but failed visible identity separation. High structural similarity does NOT certify natural anatomy.
